items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I just know Eddie and Lawrence. Huh? I knew Eddie and Lawrence Marrero, but not John, or Simon, or Billy.

ctx.x: Whose band was that? Lee Collins, Drew Rovershock. Or Albert Morton.
John Marrero. You don't know him? No, I just know Eddie and Lawrence. Huh? I knew Eddie and Lawrence Marrero, but not John, or Simon, or Billy.

He used a guitar player. Banjo player too. Yeah. Yeah, he's out. Did he have a good beat? Yeah, man. That guy could flip, man. Yeah. Yeah. He went to New York, he died. Yeah. Well, you know, some guys can play a lot of notes, but
